name: McMaster University
summary: Hamilton, Ontario university with 45 direct-entry undergraduate programs, known for problem-based, self-directed learning in health and science.

ib.text: IB Diploma with six subjects, three HL and three SL, plus TOK and EE; bonus points count in a total out of 45. A minimum 80% average is needed to apply; each program sets its own minimum.

dates.label: Engineering: recommended date for the supplementary application
Engineering: supplementary application deadline, 11:59 p.m. ET

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A shared Level 1 Engineering year of project-based, hands-on classes, then 11 disciplines from Chemical to Software, with flexible co-op terms. Start in the Discovery Track to explore, or apply straight to a discipline.
programmes.ib: A required Supplementary Application of three video answers and one written answer. Use the Admission Requirements tool to see which IB subjects each discipline asks for.
programmes.selectionNote: Marks plus a required video-based Supplementary Application assessing engagement, collaboration, creativity and resilience. Discovery Track places are decided later on Level 1 GPA.

flagshipSource.title: McMaster Engineering: project-based first year, flexible co-op and a Discovery Track across 11 disciplines

programmes.name: Honours Health Sciences
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary study of health and illness from biological, behavioural and population perspectives, built around Inquiry courses in small groups, with a research project or thesis in the final year.
programmes.ib: A required Supplementary Application, read with your grades. Level I also asks for English, Biology and Chemistry plus one course outside math, science and technology.
programmes.selectionNote: Marks and a mandatory Supplementary Application, due in February. Enrolment is limited, so apply as early as you can.

flagshipSource.title: Honours Health Sciences: unique Inquiry courses and problem-based, self-directed learning

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: A video-based Supplementary Application is required for Engineering, Computer Science, iBioMed and Technology.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
faculties.line: Honours Health Sciences and Nursing add a supplementary application or CASPer test to your grades.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Most programs are grade-based; Arts & Science and Honours Integrated Science add a supplementary application.

faculties.name: DeGroote School of Business
faculties.line: Business takes an optional supplementary submission alongside your grades.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities
faculties.line: Mostly grade-based; Integrated Business and Humanities and Wilson College add a supplementary application.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
faculties.line: No supplementary application is listed for Social Sciences entry programs; check each program's requirements.

notes: McMaster publishes IB requirements through an Admission Requirements tool you filter by program, not as a page of IB scores; its dates are a Dates and Deadlines tool.
IB Maths AI SL is treated as Pre-Calculus plus Statistics, with no Calculus credit; Maths AA SL and AI HL count as Pre-Calculus and Calculus.
HL courses with a final 5 or higher may earn advanced credit at the faculty's discretion.
